key_insight: RollVerify makes partial-rollout reinforcement learning both faster and more accurate by verifying trajectories before training instead of only reweighting them afterward.
engineering_relevance: The method improves GPU utilization and lowers training cost for long-context RL, which is important for scalable reasoning-tuning of large language models.
method: Defines an off-policy shift metric (OPS) to measure how far partial trajectories deviate from on-policy data.
Uses OPS-guided sequence-level and token-level verification to detect and truncate invalid suffixes.
Keeps high-quality partial-rollout samples for training while reducing stale off-policy noise.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that RollVerify matches on-policy accuracy on mathematical and tool-assisted reasoning tasks while reducing training cost, with preliminary gains also shown on code generation.
watch_item: The verification and truncation pipeline adds extra logic and may depend on carefully chosen OPS thresholds to avoid discarding useful trajectory content.
paper_title: RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning
